name: MonthInput
description: an input for selecting a month and year <input type="month">
status: beta — implemented and unit-tested in all seven frameworks with an axe-clean demo page; not yet exercised in composed flows
aria: `aria-label={label}` -- provides an accessible name describing the purpose of the month input
keyboard: No keyboard interactions — this is a passive element
props: `label`: string (required) -- accessible name for the input via `aria-label`
`value`: string (default: `""`) -- current month value in `YYYY-MM` format; bindable with two-way `value` binding
`required`: boolean (default: `false`) -- whether the input is required
`disabled`: boolean (default: `false`) -- whether the input is disabled
`...restProps`: unknown -- additional attributes spread onto the `<input>` element
